build_granite_speech_model: build an inference-only IBM Granite speech model for audio transcription and translation
create_multimodal_processor: create a multimodal processor that replaces audio tokens with Mel spectrogram feature counts in prompts
run_audio_encoder: run a CTC encoder with conformer blocks to extract audio embeddings from Mel spectrogram features
test_qformer_projector: test the QFormer projector that compresses encoder outputs into LLM-compatible embeddings
review_transcription_prompt: review the generation prompt builder for speech-to-text transcription and translation tasks
